**Verdict: Needs changes before merge.**

Thank you for this work. The check logic is careful and the tests are good. Two items block the merge. Both are small.

### What looks good

- The check is silent on all error states. It has no `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!()` outside tests.
- The HTTP client has no redirects, a connect timeout, a total timeout and a 512 KiB response limit.
- `is_safe_release_url` accepts only `https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/releases/...`. The notice checks the URL again before the click opens it. `browser_open` refuses shell metacharacters.
- The throttle uses saturating arithmetic. A clock that goes back by more than 24 h starts a new check.
- The check starts only in `shell_window::run_windowed`. Unit and headless tests never use the network. The app test uses a loopback server only.
- The toggle does not change the document history or the dirty state. The tests pin this.
- `prefs.rs` goes from 417 to 262 lines with the split into `prefs_setups.rs`.
- The `donate.rs` launcher code moves to `browser_open.rs` with no change in behaviour.
- The body has a `Changelog:` line. `Refs #2428` is correct for partial work (Part B only).
- No new crate dependency: `reqwest`, `tokio`, `url` and `serde_json` are already dependencies of `camcraft-app`.

### Results, merged with upstream/main `e313aa663` (built locally)

The trial merge is clean.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 22 steps, 0 failed (5.8 min) |
| app suites: lib | 297 passed |
| app suites: update_check | 4 passed |
| app suites: view_prefs | 10 passed |
| ui suites: lib | 1465 passed, 8 ignored (this includes the 4 `egui_app::tests::update_check::*` tests) |
| ui integration suites (16 binaries) | all ok |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main` | 3 steps, 0 failed (motion light: lib, motion light: adaptive_troch_parallel) |

Extra suites run: none were owed. The diff does not change `testdata/`, fixtures, goldens or import code.

Mutations: not run. The PR does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation or geometry. This is not a safety-tier review.

### Heavy lanes

The diff reaches 211 `app heavy` steps through `crates/app/src/lib.rs`. This review did not run them. Under the current AGENTS.md (#3556, "Heavy lanes at review"), a `P6` PR gets no heavy step, and the light lane above is the review result. The PR body says "owed to the wave run before merge (#3467)". That rule is retired (#3556). Please remove that sentence and name the light lane result instead.

### Requested before merge

1. **No before/after screenshots.** The PR adds a `Settings` button and an `Update available: vX.Y.Z` button to the ribbon top band (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs:1159-1171`, `settings_drop.rs`, `update_notice.rs`). A UI change needs before/after screenshots in the PR body. Add these images:
   - the top band before the change;
   - the top band after the change, with the notice visible (for example a test build with `update_available` set);
   - the open `Settings` dropdown with `Check for updates` on and off.

   Put the images on an image branch of your fork, not in the PR tree. Link them from the PR body.
2. **Code shape: `crates/app/src/update_check.rs` reads none of the five.** AGENTS.md "`app` holds the document, nothing else" puts new code in `crates/app/src` only if it reads or writes the ECS world, the project file, a command, MCP or the CLI. The `use` lines of the new file (`crates/app/src/update_check.rs:11-12`) name only `serde::Deserialize` and `url::Url`. Do one of these:
   - Move the pure logic (`parse_semver`, `is_newer_version`, `should_check_now`, `is_safe_release_url`, `parse_latest_release`) out of `app`. Keep only the HTTP fetch where `reqwest` is.
   - Or keep the file in `app`, and add to `docs/decisions/2428-update-check-ui.md` why it stays there. State that only `camcraft-app` has `reqwest` and `tokio` (as `app::ai::http` does), and that a move to `camcraft-ui` adds a new dependency. Name the dropped option. The maintainer then decides.

### Questions and notes (not blocking)

- A failed check (offline, rate limit) also writes `lastUpdateCheckUtc` (`crates/ui/src/update_check.rs:73`). The next check is then 24 h later, not at the next start. This agrees with "at most once a day". If you want a retry at the next start after an error, send `checked_at_utc: None` on `Err`.
- The `Check for updates` toggle writes `prefs.json` directly and is not an undoable command. This agrees with the theme and colour-vision preferences, which are per-user and not part of the document.
- This is a `feat` PR. It merges at the next minor cut.
- `crates/ui/src/state.rs` (5034 lines) and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs` (1682 lines) are already over the 400-line limit. The PR adds 17 and 22 lines. This is not blocking.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Moving to draft to add the requested before/after ribbon and Settings screenshots, document why `update_check` stays in `camcraft-app`, refresh with `upstream/main` for `gate light`, and return ready for re-review.

Addressed all review items on head `56455868968431c75f408f092f07675c134e5827` (merged `upstream/main`, `git merge-tree` exit 0):

1. Added the four requested `1280x720` screenshots (top band before, top band with `Update available: v99.1.0`, and open `Settings` dropdown with `Check for updates` on and off) on fork branch `pr-screenshots/3547` and linked them in the PR body.
2. Updated `docs/decisions/2428-update-check-ui.md` to record why `crates/app/src/update_check.rs` stays in `camcraft-app` (`reqwest` and `tokio` live only in `camcraft-app`, as in `ai::http`) and to name the dropped helper-split option so the maintainer can decide.
3. Replaced the retired heavy-lane wording in the PR body with the fresh `cargo xtask gate light` result (`3 steps, 0 failed`) plus `camcraft-app` (`lib` 303, `update_check` 4, `view_prefs` 10), `camcraft-ui` (`1526 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored`), and `clippy` (exit 0).

This branch is ready for a re-check.

2. **Module placement decision: fixed.** Commit `56455868968431c75f408f092f07675c134e5827` adds the requested reason to `docs/decisions/2428-update-check-ui.md`. It names the existing HTTP dependencies and the dropped helper split. This meets the documented option in the earlier review.
3. **Verification wording: fixed.** The body replaces the retired heavy-lane wording with the light result and the named test results.

I checked these items against the author's [Addressed comment](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3547#issuecomment-7104028979).

heavy lanes green on 56455868968431c75f408f092f07675c134e5827: `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`, 62 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. Base: `01e177bf5d1423fe2515ad0dc6947263ca0e6800`, tested on 2026-11-23 UTC.

The heavy gate includes two known-fail checks. Each failed at its expected assertion, so each gate step passed:

- #1950: `the_users_whole_model_bore_roughs_adaptive_on_each_level`.
- #2849: `fig8_outside_containment_with_em0800_and_clearing_kinds_works`.

Both issues are open. These are existing known failures, not new regressions. The heavy `example_catalog` step also passed.

### Extra suites run

None required by the extra selection rules. The PR changes no fixture, golden, importer, post, operation, motion, or catalog file.

Mutations: not required. The PR changes no posted G-code, gouge check, collision check, stock simulation, or geometry. No golden moved.

The tests cover version comparison, the daily throttle, loopback HTTP failures, preference persistence, the toggle, and the update notice. The UI tests keep document history and the dirty state unchanged.

Not exercised: the live GitHub request, wasm32 compilation, and native browser launch on other operating systems.

Requested before merge: none. The worktree and branch remain in place to keep the build warm. No PR code or review evidence was committed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
